classification.difficultyReason: Find the common vertex and intersections with given vertical/horizontal boundary, identify perpendicular distances and calculate areas.

content.prompt: Find the area of the triangle formed by the lines $x-y=4$, $y=-x$ and the line:

answer.worked:
The first two lines intersect where
$$\begin{align*}x-(-x)&=4\\2x&=4\\x&=2\\y&=-2.\end{align*}$$
On $x=5$, the other vertices are $(5,1)$ and $(5,-5)$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Base}&=1-(-5)=6\\\text{Perpendicular height}&=5-2=3\\\text{Area}&=\frac12\times6\times3\\\text{Area}&=9\text{ square units}.\end{align*}$$

spec.mathematics: Vertices (2,-2), (5,1), (5,-5); vertical base 6 and horizontal height 3.
